verses.kjv: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!
verses.modern: How the city sits alone — once full of people! She has become like a widow. She was great among the nations, a princess among the provinces. Now she is made to pay tribute.

verses.kjv: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
verses.modern: She weeps bitterly in the night. Tears run down her cheeks. Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her. They have become her enemies.

verses.kjv: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
verses.modern: Judah has gone into exile because of her suffering and harsh slavery. She lives among the nations and finds no rest. All her pursuers caught her in a narrow place.

verses.kjv: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate, her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.
verses.modern: The roads to Zion mourn, for no one comes to her appointed festivals. All her gates are empty. Her priests sigh. Her young women grieve. She is in bitter anguish.

verses.kjv: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
verses.modern: Her enemies have become rulers. Her foes prosper. For the LORD has made her suffer because of her many transgressions. Her children have gone into captivity before the enemy.

verses.kjv: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
verses.modern: All the splendor has left the daughter of Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture. They flee without strength before the one who pursues them.

verses.kjv: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.
verses.modern: Jerusalem, in the days of her suffering and wandering, remembers all the precious things she had in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands and there was no one to help, her enemies looked on and mocked at her downfall.

verses.kjv: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
verses.modern: Jerusalem has sinned greatly. Therefore she has become filthy. All who honored her now despise her, for they have seen her shame. She herself sighs and turns away.

verses.kjv: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.
verses.modern: Her uncleanness clung to her skirts. She gave no thought to her future. Her fall was astonishing. She had no comforter. "O LORD, look on my suffering, for the enemy has triumphed."

verses.kjv: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.
verses.modern: The enemy stretched out his hand over all her treasures. She watched as nations entered her sanctuary — the nations you commanded should not enter your congregation.

verses.kjv: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.
verses.modern: All her people groan as they search for bread. They trade their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. "Look, O LORD, and take note, for I have become despised."

verses.kjv: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.modern: "Is it nothing to You, all who pass by? Look and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow — the sorrow the LORD has brought on me in the day of His fierce anger."

verses.kjv: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.
verses.modern: From above He sent fire into my bones and it spread through them. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He has left me desolate, in misery all day long.

verses.kjv: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the LORD hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.
verses.modern: The yoke of my transgressions has been fastened by His hand. They are twisted together and laid on my neck. He has drained my strength. The LORD has handed me over to those I cannot resist.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the LORD hath trodden the virgin daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.
verses.modern: The Lord has rejected all my mighty warriors. He summoned an army against me to crush my young men. The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah like grapes in a winepress.

verses.kjv: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
verses.modern: For these things I weep. My eyes overflow with tears. Any comforter who might restore me is far away. My children are desolate because the enemy has triumphed.

verses.kjv: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
verses.modern: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The LORD has commanded that Jacob's neighbors should be his enemies. Jerusalem is as unclean in their midst.

verses.kjv: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
verses.modern: "The LORD is righteous, for I rebelled against His commands. Listen, all You peoples, and see my sorrow. My young women and my young men have gone into captivity."

verses.kjv: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
verses.modern: I called to my allies, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders perished in the city while searching for food to keep themselves alive.

verses.kjv: Behold, O LORD; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.
verses.modern: "Look, O LORD, for I am in distress. My stomach churns. My heart is wrung within me, for I have been very rebellious. In the streets the sword kills. At home there is death."

verses.kjv: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
verses.modern: They have heard my groaning. There is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble. They are glad that You have done it. But You will bring the day You have announced, and they will become like me.

verses.kjv: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
verses.modern: "Let all their wickedness come before You. Deal with them as You have dealt with me for all my transgressions. For my groans are many and my heart is sick."

chapters.summary: The poet mourns Jerusalem sitting alone like a widow, once great among the nations but now paying tribute. Her allies have betrayed her, her people have gone into captivity, and her enemies prosper because the LORD has afflicted her for her many transgressions. Jerusalem herself cries out that there is no sorrow like her sorrow and acknowledges that the LORD is righteous, for she has rebelled against His commands.

verses.kjv: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
verses.modern: How the Lord has covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud of His anger! He has thrown down from heaven to earth the splendor of Israel. He did not remember His footstool in the day of His anger.

verses.kjv: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
verses.modern: The Lord has swallowed up without pity all the dwellings of Jacob. In his wrath he has torn down the strongholds of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them down to the ground. He has dishonored the kingdom and its princes.

verses.kjv: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.
verses.modern: In His fierce anger He has cut off every defender of Israel. He has pulled back His right hand from before the enemy. He has burned against Jacob like a blazing fire that consumes everything around it.

verses.kjv: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
verses.modern: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has taken His stand like a foe with His right hand raised. He has killed all who were precious in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion. He poured out His wrath like fire.

verses.kjv: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
verses.modern: The Lord has become like an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

verses.kjv: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
verses.modern: He has torn down His tabernacle as easily as a garden shed. He has destroyed His appointed place. The LORD has made Zion forget her festivals and her Sabbaths. In His fierce anger He has rejected king and priest alike.

verses.kjv: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.
verses.modern: The Lord has abandoned His altar and rejected His sanctuary. He has handed over the walls of her palaces to the enemy. They shout in the house of the LORD as on a day of appointed festival.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line; he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
verses.modern: The LORD purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion. He stretched out the measuring line. He did not hold back His hand from destroying. He made the rampart and the wall lament. They sank into ruin together.

verses.kjv: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.
verses.modern: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken their bars. Her king and princes are among the nations. The law is no more. Her prophets receive no vision from the LORD.

verses.kjv: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
verses.modern: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence. They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.

verses.kjv: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
verses.modern: My eyes are worn out from weeping. My stomach churns. My heart is poured out on the ground because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, as children and infants faint in the streets of the city.

verses.kjv: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.
verses.modern: They cry to their mothers, "Where is food and drink?" as they faint like wounded men in the streets of the city, as their lives pour out on their mothers' laps.

verses.kjv: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?
verses.modern: "What can I say to You? What can I compare to You, O daughter of Jerusalem? What can I equal you to, that I might comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion? Your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can heal You?"

verses.kjv: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.
verses.modern: Your prophets have seen false and worthless visions for You. They did not expose Your iniquity to turn away Your captivity. The visions they proclaimed were lies and delusions.

verses.kjv: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
verses.modern: All who pass by clap their hands at You. They hiss and shake their heads at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, "Is this the city they called the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth?"

verses.kjv: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
verses.modern: All Your enemies open their mouths against You. They hiss and grind their teeth and say, "We have swallowed her up. This is the day we were waiting for. We have found it. We have seen it."

verses.kjv: The LORD hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
verses.modern: The LORD has done what He planned. He has carried out His word that He commanded long ago. He has torn down without pity. He has let Your enemy gloat over You and has given power to Your foes.

verses.kjv: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.
verses.modern: Their heart cried out to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears flow like a river day and night. Give Yourself no relief. Let Your eyes have no rest.

verses.kjv: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
verses.modern: Rise, cry out in the night. At the beginning of every watch, pour out Your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift Your hands to Him for the lives of Your children, who faint from hunger on every street corner.

verses.kjv: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.modern: "Look, O LORD, and see who You have dealt with this way. Should women eat their own children, the babies they have carried? Should priest and prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?"

verses.kjv: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.
verses.modern: "Young and old lie together in the dust of the streets. My young women and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed them in the day of Your anger. You have slaughtered without pity."

verses.kjv: Thou hast called as in a solemn feast day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD's anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
verses.modern: "You summoned terrors against me from every side, as though calling people to an appointed festival. In the day of the LORD's anger no one escaped. No one survived. The children I carried and raised, my enemy has destroyed."

chapters.summary: The poet describes the LORD acting as an enemy against His own people — swallowing up the dwellings of Jacob, destroying the temple, and making Zion forget her festivals. Her prophets gave false visions and did not expose her iniquity. Children faint in the streets, women eat their own offspring, and the poet cries out for Zion to pour out her heart like water before the Lord.

verses.kjv: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.modern: I am the man who has seen suffering under the rod of God's wrath.

verses.kjv: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
verses.modern: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness rather than light.

verses.kjv: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
verses.modern: He has turned His hand against me again and again, all day long.

verses.kjv: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
verses.modern: He has worn away my flesh and skin. He has broken my bones.

verses.kjv: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
verses.modern: He has built up walls against me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

verses.kjv: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
verses.modern: He has made me sit in darkness like those who have been dead for ages.

verses.kjv: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
verses.modern: He has walled me in so I cannot escape. He has weighed me down with heavy chains.

verses.kjv: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
verses.modern: Even when I cry out and call for help, He shuts out my prayer.

verses.kjv: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
verses.modern: He has blocked my paths with cut stone. He has made my roads twisted and impassable.

verses.kjv: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
verses.modern: He has been to me like a bear lying in ambush, like a lion lurking in hiding.

verses.kjv: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
verses.modern: He dragged me off my path and tore me apart. He has left me desolate.

verses.kjv: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.modern: He bent his bow and set me as a target for his arrows.

verses.kjv: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
verses.modern: He drove the arrows from His quiver deep into my body.

verses.kjv: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
verses.modern: I have become the mockery of all my people — their song all day long.

verses.kjv: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
verses.modern: He has filled me with bitterness. He has made me drink deeply of wormwood.

verses.kjv: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
verses.modern: He has ground my teeth on gravel. He has pressed my face into the dust.

verses.kjv: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
verses.modern: You have banished my soul from peace. I have forgotten what prosperity is.

verses.kjv: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
verses.modern: I said, "My strength and my hope have perished from the LORD."

verses.kjv: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
verses.modern: I remember my suffering and my wandering — the bitterness and the poison.

verses.kjv: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
verses.modern: My soul remembers and is brought low within me.

verses.kjv: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
verses.modern: Yet this I call to mind, and therefore I have hope:

verses.kjv: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.modern: It is because of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed. His compassions never fail.

verses.kjv: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.modern: They are new every morning. Great is Your faithfulness.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.modern: "The LORD is my portion," says my soul. "Therefore I will hope in Him."

verses.kjv: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
verses.modern: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul that seeks Him.

verses.kjv: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
verses.modern: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.

verses.kjv: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.modern: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is young.

verses.kjv: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
verses.modern: Let Him sit alone in silence when God lays it on Him.

verses.kjv: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
verses.modern: Let Him put His face in the dust — there may yet be hope.

verses.kjv: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
verses.modern: Let Him offer His cheek to one who strikes Him. Let Him be filled with disgrace.

verses.kjv: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
verses.modern: For the Lord will not reject forever.

verses.kjv: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.modern: Even if He brings grief, He will show compassion — so great is His mercy.

verses.kjv: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
verses.modern: For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the children of men.

verses.kjv: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.modern: He does not want to crush under His feet all the prisoners of the earth

verses.kjv: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
verses.modern: or to deny a man his rights before the Most High

verses.kjv: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
verses.modern: or to deprive a man of justice. The Lord does not approve of these things.

verses.kjv: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
verses.modern: Who can speak and have it happen if the Lord has not commanded it?

verses.kjv: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
verses.modern: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that both disaster and good things come?

verses.kjv: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.modern: Why should any living person complain when punished for His sins?

verses.kjv: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
verses.modern: Let us examine and test our ways and turn back to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
verses.modern: Let us lift up our hearts and our hands to God in heaven.

verses.kjv: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
verses.modern: We have sinned and rebelled. You have not forgiven.

verses.kjv: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
verses.modern: You wrapped Yourself in anger and pursued us. You have killed without pity.

verses.kjv: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
verses.modern: You covered Yourself with a cloud so that no prayer could pass through.

verses.kjv: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
verses.modern: You have made us filth and garbage among the peoples.

verses.kjv: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.modern: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

verses.kjv: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
verses.modern: We have experienced panic and the pit — devastation and destruction.

verses.kjv: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.modern: Rivers of tears flow from my eyes because of the destruction of the daughter of my people.

verses.kjv: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
verses.modern: My eyes will keep flowing without stopping

verses.kjv: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.modern: until the LORD looks down and sees from heaven.

verses.kjv: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.modern: My eyes bring me pain because of all the women of my city.

verses.kjv: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
verses.modern: My enemies hunted me relentlessly like a bird — though I had done nothing wrong.

verses.kjv: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
verses.modern: They threw me alive into a pit and dropped a stone on top of me.

verses.kjv: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
verses.modern: The waters closed over my head. I said, "I am finished."

verses.kjv: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
verses.modern: I called on Your name, O LORD, from the depths of the pit.

verses.kjv: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.modern: You heard my voice. Do not hide Your ear from my cry for relief, from my plea.

verses.kjv: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verses.modern: You came near when I called on You. You said, "Do not be afraid."

verses.kjv: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.modern: O Lord, You have taken up my cause. You have reclaimed my life.

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong; judge thou my cause.
verses.modern: O LORD, You have seen the wrong done to me. Uphold my cause.

verses.kjv: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
verses.modern: You have seen all their acts of revenge, all their schemes against me.

verses.kjv: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;
verses.modern: You have heard their insults, O LORD, all their plots against me —

verses.kjv: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.modern: the words of those who rise against me, their schemes against me all day long.

verses.kjv: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
verses.modern: Whether they sit or stand, look — I am the subject of their mocking songs.

verses.kjv: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
verses.modern: Pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, according to what their hands have done.

verses.kjv: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
verses.modern: Give them hearts that are hardened. Let Your curse be on them.

verses.kjv: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
verses.modern: Pursue them in anger and wipe them out from under the heavens of the LORD.

chapters.summary: The poet speaks as one who has suffered under God's wrath — driven into darkness, walled in, and torn apart. Yet in the middle of his despair he declares that it is because of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, that His compassions are new every morning, and that great is His faithfulness. He calls the people to examine their ways and return to the LORD, then cries out for God to judge his enemies.

verses.kjv: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
verses.modern: How the gold has grown dim! How the finest gold has changed! The sacred stones lie scattered at every street corner.

verses.kjv: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
verses.modern: The precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in gold — now they are counted as mere clay pots, the work of a potter's hands.

verses.kjv: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.modern: Even jackals nurse their young, but the daughter of my people has become heartless — like an ostrich in the desert.

verses.kjv: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.
verses.modern: The nursing infant's tongue sticks to the roof of its mouth from thirst. Children beg for bread, but no one gives them any.

verses.kjv: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
verses.modern: Those who once ate fine food are starving in the streets. Those who grew up in luxury are picking through garbage heaps.

verses.kjv: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
verses.modern: The punishment for the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the penalty of Sodom, which was destroyed in a moment with no one to help her.

verses.kjv: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
verses.modern: Her Nazarites were purer than snow and whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their appearance was like sapphire.

verses.kjv: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
verses.modern: Now their faces are blacker than soot. They are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shrunk to their bones. It has dried up and become like wood.

verses.kjv: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
verses.modern: Those killed by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced by the lack of food from the fields.

verses.kjv: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.modern: Compassionate women boiled their own children. Their children became their food during the destruction of the daughter of my people.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
verses.modern: The LORD has given full vent to His wrath. He has poured out His fierce anger. He set a fire in Zion that consumed her very foundations.

verses.kjv: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: The kings of the earth could not believe — nor could any of the world's inhabitants — that an enemy or foe would ever enter the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her.
verses.modern: It happened because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed the blood of the righteous within her.

verses.kjv: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, insomuch that men could not touch their garments.
verses.modern: They staggered through the streets like blind men, so defiled with blood that no one could touch their clothing.

verses.kjv: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.
verses.modern: "Go away! Unclean!" people cried to them. "Go away! Away! Do not touch!" When they fled and wandered, the nations said, "They will stay here no longer."

verses.kjv: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
verses.modern: The LORD Himself scattered them. He will look on them no more. The people showed no respect to the priests and no honor to the elders.

verses.kjv: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
verses.modern: Our eyes strained with watching for help that never came. We kept watch from our towers for a nation that could not save us.

verses.kjv: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
verses.modern: They hunt our steps so we cannot walk in our own streets. Our end is near. Our days are numbered. Our end has come.

verses.kjv: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.modern: Our pursuers were swifter than eagles in the sky. They chased us over the mountains. They lay in ambush for us in the desert.

verses.kjv: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
verses.modern: The anointed of the LORD — the breath of our life — was caught in their traps, the one of whom we said, "Under His shadow we will live among the nations."

verses.kjv: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
verses.modern: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, you who live in the land of Uz. But the cup will pass to you as well. You will get drunk and expose Yourself.

verses.kjv: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
verses.modern: Your punishment is complete, O daughter of Zion. He will not send you into exile again. But He will punish your iniquity, O daughter of Edom. He will expose your sins.

chapters.summary: The poet mourns how the gold has grown dim and the precious sons of Zion are counted as clay pots. Famine has devastated the city — children beg for bread, compassionate women have boiled their own children, and the punishment exceeds that of Sodom. The LORD has poured out His full wrath because of the sins of her prophets and priests. The poet warns Edom that the cup will pass to her as well.

verses.kjv: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
verses.modern: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace.

verses.kjv: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
verses.modern: Our inheritance has been given over to strangers, our homes to foreigners.

verses.kjv: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
verses.modern: We have become orphans without a father. Our mothers are like widows.

verses.kjv: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
verses.modern: We have had to buy our own water to drink. Our own wood costs us money.

verses.kjv: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
verses.modern: We are driven hard with a yoke on our necks. We labor with no rest.

verses.kjv: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.modern: We stretched out our hands to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread to eat.

verses.kjv: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
verses.modern: Our fathers sinned and are no more, but we bear their iniquities.

verses.kjv: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
verses.modern: Servants rule over us. There is no one to rescue us from their hand.

verses.kjv: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.modern: We risk our lives to get our bread because of the sword in the desert.

verses.kjv: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
verses.modern: Our skin has become as hot as an oven because of the burning heat of famine.

verses.kjv: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
verses.modern: Women were violated in Zion, young women in the cities of Judah.

verses.kjv: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
verses.modern: Princes were hung up by their hands. The faces of the elders were shown no honor.

verses.kjv: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
verses.modern: Young men were put to work at the grinding stone. Boys staggered under loads of wood.

verses.kjv: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
verses.modern: The elders no longer sit at the city gate. The young men no longer play music.

verses.kjv: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.modern: The joy of our hearts has ended. Our dancing has turned to mourning.

verses.kjv: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
verses.modern: The crown has fallen from our head. How terrible it is for us, for we have sinned!

verses.kjv: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
verses.modern: Because of this our hearts are sick. Because of these things our eyes have grown dim.

verses.kjv: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
verses.modern: Mount Zion lies desolate. Foxes prowl over it.

verses.kjv: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
verses.modern: But You, O LORD, reign forever. Your throne endures from generation to generation.

verses.kjv: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
verses.modern: Why do You forget us forever? Why do You forsake us so long?

verses.kjv: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
verses.modern: Turn us to Yourself, O LORD, and we shall be turned. Renew our days as of old.

verses.kjv: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
verses.modern: Unless You have completely rejected us and are angry with us beyond measure.

chapters.summary: The poet pleads with the LORD to remember what has happened — their inheritance given to strangers, their people made orphans, servants ruling over them, and women violated in Zion. The joy of their hearts has ceased and their dancing has turned to mourning. Yet he affirms that the LORD reigns forever and pleads, "Turn us to Yourself, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old."
